skill_name: Describe how a GPT language model can be used to generate text.
workflow: A GPT language model can be used to generate text by taking in a set of text as input, analyzing it, and then using that analysis to predict the next word or phrase that should be generated. This process is repeated with each successive word or phrase, until the desired output is generated. GPT language models can be trained on large amounts of data, allowing them to capture unique linguistic patterns and generate realistic output that follows the style and structure of the source text.
